1.web: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
1.asv: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.

2.web: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
2.asv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I callupon himas long as I live.

3.web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
3.asv: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

4.web: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
4.asv: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

5.web: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
5.asv: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.

6.web: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
6.asv: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

7.web: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
7.asv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

8.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
8.asv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, Andmy feet from falling.

9.web: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
9.asv: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.

10.web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
10.asv: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:

11.web: I said in my haste, “All men are liars.”
11.asv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

12.web: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
12.asv: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?

13.web: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
13.asv: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.

14.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
14.asv: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.

15.web: Precious in the sight of Yahweh is the death of his saints.
15.asv: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.

16.web: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your handmaid. You have freed me from my chains.
16.asv: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.

17.web: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
17.asv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.

18.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
18.asv: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,

19.web: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
19.asv: In the courts of Jehovah’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
